expectation_basis: Pinned parser/scanner obligations retained from v1. Only the XML parse expectation is corrected using the saved exact v1 native transports and the pinned future/future migration thresholds. These remain expectations for an unexecuted v2 reader, not admitted coverage or source counts.

parity_contract.baseline: Unmodified Parsers.Parser over the complete source, with the same pinned compiler, settings and dependency classpath.
parity_contract.candidate: The separate observed-scanner candidate over identical source bytes; do not substitute a standalone scanner walk.
parity_contract.isolation: Use a fresh CompilationUnit, reporter and per-input context for each side. Preserve initialization evidence and the exact comparison setup.
compare: Exact source bytes, decoded text and UTF-16 to UTF-8 boundary mapping
Incoming diagnostics including class, message, level and complete position; compare constructor diagnostics too

Exact complete stock and observed transport JSON, including untyped graph structure, node/source IDs, values, native spans, sources, modifiers and end-marker fields; no normalization or structural-bijection allowance
Parser-owned comments including native raw text and unmodified native spans
forbid: Dropping a differing diagnostic or graph node to make parity pass
Counting speculative LookaheadScanner scans as additional main-scanner physical events
Treating EOF, INDENT, OUTDENT or inferred separators as written source characters
Accepting coverage for a source with parser/scanner errors, XML handoff, unexplained overlap or unexplained non-whitespace gaps

coverage_contract.coordinates: Native offsets are retained as UTF-16 coordinates; byte intervals use the separately checked boundary map. Never split a surrogate pair.
coverage_contract.freshness: Determine next.token == EMPTY before the corresponding nextToken or peekAhead call. Record one fresh result before layout insertion/fusion; buffered replays do not create another physical event.
coverage_contract.interpolation: For STRINGPART with native prefetched next, retain the literal fragment ending at next.offset and the prefetched token ending at lastCharOffset. Preserve next.token, including THIS. For ${...}, the brace starts at lastCharOffset and remains executable syntax.
coverage_contract.comments: Preserve native comment raw text and spans exactly. Native comment ends can include the CR immediately before LF; retain that discrepancy explicitly and permit only the reviewed CRLF relationship, without blanket trimming or silently changing native spans.
coverage_contract.residuals: Every source character must be covered by a retained physical event, a retained native comment interval, or an explicitly checked whitespace interval. Raw literal content is protected; executable interpolation is separately visible.
coverage_contract.required_raw_lexemes: The listed exact source fragments must be retained as physical events. A native_token_constant, when supplied, names a pinned Tokens.scala constant and must match the event numeric token through native_token_constants. Do not compare it to the reader token_name display label. occurrence is zero-based among exact substring matches and identifies the intended source fragment; these anchors do not replace full-source coverage.
coverage_contract.rejection_evidence: Retain diagnostics and partial events on rejected cases. Rejection never creates a count or a successful coverage claim.
